source: quantflow `backtest` pipeline (run_backtest + Phase 2 portfolio constructor, config/settings.yaml as committed) run in-process on the project's cached DuckDB store (Yahoo daily bars, point-in-time S&P 500 ∪ NDX membership), 2026-11-19; read-only, nothing written to the project

sleeves.name: momentum
sleeves.description: 12-1 cross-sectional momentum: rank the point-in-time S&P 500 ∪ Nasdaq-100 universe by 12-month return skipping the last month, drop the most volatile decile and illiquid names (<$20M ADV), hold the top 20 equal-weighted, rebalance monthly.

sleeves.name: mean_reversion
sleeves.description: Short-horizon reversion: buy liquid names (>$50M ADV) above their 200-day SMA after a 2.5σ dip in the 20-day z-score; exit at −0.5σ or after 20 sessions; 10 fixed slots, oldest trades keep their slot; entries blacked out around earnings.

signals.note: Target book after blending (sleeve weight × 0.84 static gross scale) and caps (8% name, 30% sector). Score = the sleeve's own ranking input from Strategy.explain().

equityCurve.frequency: weekly (Friday close; last point is the final session)

readmePublished.note: Headline table from README.md (2015-01 → 2026-09, net 10bps/side, 1-day lag). Current config uses execution_lag 2, which is why the fresh run above is lower.
